meta.tagline: Turn any PDF into 4 study materials in 1 minute.
meta.description: AI study assistant built for college and grad-school students. Upload a lecture slide deck, a research paper, or any PDF and get structured notes, a mind map, flashcards, and AI Q&A in under a minute. 3 free notes (lifetime) — no credit card required.

home.heroDesc: Upload a lecture deck, a research paper, or any PDF. In about a minute, MindFlow turns it into four ready-to-study materials: structured notes, a mind map, flashcards, and AI Q&A. Finals, GRE, MCAT, CFA — the material adapts to how you study.
home.heroSubline: 3 free notes (lifetime) · No credit card · 1-minute output · Upgrade $4.99/month
home.ctaFootnote: 1-minute upload · 1-minute output · No credit card · PPT / PDF / Word supported
home.closingLine: Upload your professor's slides, a research paper, or any PDF. In 1 minute you get notes, a mind map, flashcards, and AI Q&A — you don't have to learn a new tool, the knowledge adapts to fit how you study.
home.scenesSub: It's not about working harder. It's about using the right tool.
home.scene1Pain: Your professor just dropped 400 slides. You spend 3 days handwriting key points — and then there's no time left to actually study.
home.scene1Result: With MindFlow: one slide deck becomes notes + mind map + flashcards in 1 minute. Finish an entire course in an hour.
home.scene2Title: 1,000+ pages of reading you'll never finish
home.scene2Pain: Syllabus handed out, books bought, but you're stuck on chapter 3. Memorize it, forget it, memorize again — the anxiety keeps growing.
home.scene2Result: MindFlow pulls out the key exam points and turns them into flashcards on a spaced-repetition schedule. 30 cards a day, and it actually sticks.
home.scene3Pain: Eight papers on the reading list, 30+ pages each, all in dense academic English. Even after reading, you can't remember what was actually said.
home.scene3Result: Upload the PDF → bilingual notes, a key-term glossary, and AI Q&A. Read one paper in 5 minutes.
home.scene4Title: Stack of prep books, no time to read them
home.scene4Pain: Your prep books collect dust. Highlight by gut feeling, miss the actually-tested concepts, score the same on every practice test.
home.scene4Result: Upload the chapter PDF → AI marks the high-yield points, builds spaced-repetition flashcards. Walk into test day ready.
home.scene5Title: PMP, CFA, AWS cert — can't keep up with the syllabus
home.scene5Pain: Studying after work, weekends gone, and you still haven't touched chapter 4. The exam date isn't moving.
home.scene5Result: Upload the official study guide → structured notes + mind map + flashcards. Study in 20-minute daily blocks, retain more.
home.featuresSub: No switching between 4 apps · No 4 passwords to remember · No retyping.
home.featureNoteDesc: AI pulls out key concepts, exam points, and comparison tables. About 30% of the original length — review a whole chapter in 30 minutes.
home.featureMapDesc: See the whole chapter structure on one page, color-coded by level. Click to expand / collapse. No more flipping back and forth through slides.
home.featureCardDesc: 8–15 Q&A cards per chapter. The app pushes you 30 cards a day on a spaced-repetition schedule so you actually remember them.
home.featureChatDesc: Ask any question about any paragraph in your notes — answer in 3 seconds. No more digging through books, no more bothering classmates.
home.compareSub: Same 40-page biology lecture. See the difference.
home.compareOld2: Highlighting by gut feeling — easy to miss exam points
home.compareOld4: Classmate asks, you don't know — flip pages forever
home.compareOld5: Start reviewing a week before the exam — too late
home.compareNew2: AI marks must-know points and common mistakes
home.compareNew4: AI Q&A in 3 seconds — no more flipping
home.compareNew5: Learn + review together, walk into the exam calm
home.howTitle: 3 steps. No new tool to learn.
home.howSub: Upload → AI processes → get 4 materials. Whole thing takes under 2 minutes.
home.howStep1Desc: Drag & drop a PPT / PDF / Word file. Max 20MB.
home.howStep2Desc: Notes + mind map + flashcards + Q&A. Done in 1 minute.
home.howStep3Desc: Read the notes / zoom the mind map / flip flashcards / ask AI anything
home.whyBody: "I built this because I once drowned in slides during finals week."
home.whyBody2: Our founder ran 300 retail stores. He learned the hard way that repetitive manual work is the biggest efficiency killer. A student copying notes and a store owner sticking labels are the same problem — 90% of time on organizing, only 10% on real thinking.
home.whyBody3: MindFlow doesn't make big promises or fake numbers. We only recommend things we use ourselves and that actually work.
home.pricingTitle: Built for broke students. Priced accordingly.
home.pricingSub: $4.99/month · Save $20 on the annual plan · 7-day no-questions-asked refund
home.faq1Q: How is MindFlow different from ChatGPT or Notion AI?
home.faq1A: ChatGPT is a chat tool — you have to ask and organize yourself. Notion AI needs you to paste content in first. MindFlow takes a PPT or PDF directly and outputs 4 ready-to-study materials (notes / mind map / flashcards / Q&A). Zero manual work.
home.faq2A: Files are deleted immediately after processing. We don't store them on our servers, and they're not used to train any AI model. Required by our payment processor (Creem) compliance and our own promise.
home.faq3A: Yes — 100% refund within 7 days, no questions asked. Just email support@mindflow.wang and we'll process it the same business day.
home.faq4Q: Is the free plan really free forever?
home.faq4A: Yes. Free plan: 3 notes (lifetime), all 4 features unlocked. The Monthly plan is $4.99 — for finals or GRE crunchers who need unlimited.
home.ctaBottomTitle: Why wait? Try 3 free notes before your next finals.
home.ctaBottomSub: Sign up in 1 minute, get 3 free notes. If you don't subscribe after seeing them, you'll kick yourself.
